description: Land Title Settlement Department - Dethgama, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510210
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, extent, location, and encumbrances. The content focuses on property rights and land administration rather than government personnel changes, structural changes, or any other specialized category.
